verdict: RemotePeople presents a reasonably documented option for teams exploring agencies. Its 7.2/10 research score measures the quality of available buying information rather than product performance. Put it on the shortlist when its stated use case matches your needs, then validate pricing, implementation, and must-have capabilities in a live vendor conversation.

sections.body: Build world-class teams across 180+ countries. Leave the compliance, payroll and HR admin to us.

sections.heading: Where it may fit in a shortlist
sections.body: Based on its positioning under Agencies, RemotePeople is most relevant during early market discovery. The available record includes 9 category signals and 2 commercial records, giving buyers a starting point—not a substitute for requirements validation.

sections.heading: Questions to ask before buying
sections.body: Ask RemotePeople for a workflow-specific demonstration, itemized pricing, implementation responsibilities, data-processing terms, support response targets, and references from organizations with a similar scale and use case.

sections.heading: Our research perspective
sections.body: The strongest signal in this assessment is audience fit; the area requiring the most buyer diligence is product clarity. These signals describe documentation quality and should not be read as measured product performance.

faq.question: How is the RemotePeople score calculated?
faq.answer: The research score weights product clarity (28%), audience fit (24%), buyer access (18%), buying detail (18%), and record confidence (12%). It evaluates available buying information, not product performance.
